subject: general
question: The term "Exercise Cyclone - 2025," recently seen in the news, is related to:

options.text: A cyber warfare simulation program conducted by NATO
A naval drill conducted by India and the USA
A disaster management exercise in the Indian Ocean region
A joint military exercise between India and Egypt

solution: The correct answer is __**option 4**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** • The 3rd edition of Exercise CYCLONE has begun.
